name:        InfoTip
domain:      component
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/InfoTip
description: An info icon that reveals help: a small "i" button. Hover and keyboard focus preview the help, and a click, tap, Enter, or Space pins it open until Escape, a second press, a press outside, or focus leaving. Use it next to labels, values, and metrics for permission notes, metric definitions, and field help. Its value over hand-composing Icon inside Tooltip is the pre-wired accessible trigger: a real button with an aria-label, Tab-reachable, tooltip on hover AND focus AND tap, and Escape dismissal. It follows the toggletip pattern: the button reports `aria-expanded="true"` while the help is pinned, and a screen reader hears the help once when it pins.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component InfoTip

name:        useInputContainer
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Makes an input container wrapper clickable, delegating focus to the inner input/textarea when the user clicks non-interactive areas (icons, padding, status indicators). Built on top of useClickableContainer, so nested interactive elements (clear buttons, calendar toggles, links) are handled safely; clicking them does NOT steal focus from the input. Automatically detects input type: text-like inputs receive .focus(), while other types (checkbox, radio, file) receive .click().
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useInputContainer

name:        useIcon
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Icon
description: Resolves a semantic icon name to a React node through the nearest Theme, so a custom component draws the same success, warning or error icon that Astryx components draw and follows a theme that overrides it. Resolution reads the nearest Theme's icons (outside any Theme, the registered theme the document root names), then registerIcons() overrides, then the built-in default. The node is returned as is, with no size or color wrapper: the built-in icons are 1em squares in currentColor, so they follow the surrounding text. A function entry is read at {size: 'md'}. Render <Icon icon={name} /> instead when the icon needs another size, a color or a label.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useIcon
